title: Notes storage with changes and authors
steps: Open `/api/files` in this Preview. Each note has a revision: the number of the change that last wrote it.
Open `/api/file?path=Shopping.md` to see its text and revision.

In the browser console, save an edit based on that revision: `await (await fetch('/api/file', {method: 'PUT', body: JSON.stringify({path: 'Shopping.md', text: '# Shopping

- Eggs
- Bread
- Milk
- Coffee
', base: REVISION})})).json()`. It answers `saved` with a new revision.
Send another edit with the same old revision that changes a different line, such as `- Eggs` to `- 12 eggs`. It answers `merged`, and the text has both edits.
Send one more with the old revision that changes the line you already changed. It answers 409 `conflict` with the current note, and nothing is saved.
